verdict.note: The answer gets the main precedence and the company fallback right, but it wrongly says the elif loop only runs when the dicts aren't passed. In fact it runs whenever the Item Group or Brand defaults are empty, returns early, can yield a buying cost center on a sales row, and skips the company check. So the claim that every cross-company cost center is rejected is also wrong.

The answer names all six breaking callers and correctly explains why repost_stock keeps working. It misses some trigger paths (buying/selling controllers, packed items, the track_semi_finished_goods skip) and never mentions update_bin_columns. It also wrongly ties repost_stock to 'repost item valuation' instead of stock_balance.repost and Item merge.

The answer correctly sorts the three affected call sites and the two unaffected ones, with the right fallback behaviour; it never states the conditions under which the error is actually thrown (perpetual inventory, no fallbacks found, allow_zero_rate false).
